_comment: F1 — the seed payload for scripts/seed-show-visitor-info.ts.
Copy scripts/seed-ticketing.ts's structure exactly: readEnvLocal() from .env.local (NOT the
dotenv package), @sanity/client with useCdn:false, deterministic _ids, createIfNotExists.

hardRules.createIfNotExists: showVisitorInfo singleton and every showFaq document.
hardRules.setIfMissing: nationalShow.venue — patched onto the EXISTING pinned singleton, never replacing it.
prohibited: createOrReplace — anywhere in the file. This is the scripts/seed-page-singletons.ts bug: it silently reverts editor changes on every run.
.set({...}) on nationalShow — would overwrite a venue an editor has already corrected.
Empty string literals ('' or "") in any seeded object body — a seeded field that renders blank is indistinguishable from a bug.
Deleting or clearing any existing nationalShow field.
hardRules.idempotence: Running the script twice must be a no-op on the second run, and must never revert an editor's work. This is asserted.

ids.showFaq: showFaq.<category>.<n> — e.g. showFaq.getting-there.1, deterministic so a re-run collides with the existing document instead of creating a duplicate.

showVisitorInfoDocument.pendingLabel: To be confirmed by the show committee
showVisitorInfoDocument.researchLabel: Researched by the web team against the working venue — not yet confirmed by the show committee
showVisitorInfoDocument.planIntro: Everything you need to get to the National Orchid Show and make a day of it. Travel and accommodation guidance below is our own research against the working venue; the show committee will confirm the final details.
showVisitorInfoDocument.gettingThereIntro: Most visitors from outside the Western Cape arrive by air. Whichever national airport you start from, your route runs through Cape Town International.

airportRoutes.duration: Roughly 25 to 40 minutes by road, depending on traffic
airportRoutes.directions: Follow the N2 towards the city centre and take the Foreshore off-ramps. The venue sits on the Foreshore at the harbour end of the central business district.
transportOptions: MyCiTi bus route A01 runs between the airport and Civic Centre station, roughly every 20 minutes in peak periods and about hourly off-peak, taking around 30 minutes. Civic Centre station is on Hertzog Boulevard, a walk of about 600 m from the venue.
Metered taxis and e-hailing services operate from the airport's designated ranks.
Car hire desks are in the airport's central terminal building.

airportRoutes.distance: About 1 400 km — not a practical drive
airportRoutes.directions: Connect to Cape Town International, then follow the Cape Town International guidance above.
transportOptions: Domestic connecting flights run throughout the day.

airportRoutes.distance: About 1 650 km — not a practical drive
airportRoutes.directions: Connect to Cape Town International, then follow the Cape Town International guidance above.
transportOptions: Domestic connecting flights run throughout the day.

showVisitorInfoDocument.parking: Parking arrangements for show visitors have not been confirmed. The venue has multiple parking garages; rates, capacity and which garage show visitors should use will be published once the committee confirms the booking.
showVisitorInfoDocument.publicTransport: MyCiTi is Cape Town's scheduled bus service. Civic Centre station on Hertzog Boulevard is the closest stop to the working venue — about 600 m, a walk of roughly seven minutes — and is the city terminus of the A01 airport route. Metered taxis and e-hailing services operate throughout the central city.
showVisitorInfoDocument.accommodationIntro: A starting point for booking, grouped by how far you would be from the venue. These are suggestions from our own research, not recommendations or negotiated rates — SAOC has no arrangement with any property listed.

accommodation.name: Foreshore hotels adjoining the convention precinct
accommodation.note: Several large hotels sit within a few minutes' walk of the working venue. Specific properties will be listed once the venue is confirmed.

accommodation.name: V&A Waterfront
accommodation.note: About 2 km. A wide range of hotels and serviced apartments, with restaurants and the Robben Island ferry on the doorstep.

accommodation.name: City Bowl and Company's Garden
accommodation.note: About 1 to 2 km. Smaller hotels and guesthouses within walking distance of the museums and the Company's Garden.

accommodation.name: Green Point and Sea Point
accommodation.note: About 3 to 6 km. Guesthouses and self-catering apartments along the Atlantic seaboard promenade.

accommodation.name: Southern Suburbs
accommodation.note: About 10 to 15 km. Quieter, leafier, and close to Kirstenbosch — worth considering if you are extending your stay.

attractions.name: V&A Waterfront
attractions.note: About 2 km from the working venue. Shops, restaurants, the aquarium, and the departure point for Robben Island ferries.

attractions.name: Kirstenbosch National Botanical Garden
attractions.note: About 13 km. South Africa's flagship botanical garden, on the eastern slopes of Table Mountain — the obvious companion outing for a show visitor.

attractions.name: Table Mountain Aerial Cableway
attractions.note: About 6 km. Runs weather permitting; check the cableway's own status before travelling.

attractions.name: Company's Garden and the city museums
attractions.note: About 1.5 km. The original 17th-century garden, with the South African Museum and the National Gallery alongside it.

attractions.name: Bo-Kaap
attractions.note: About 2 km. Historic neighbourhood on the slopes of Signal Hill.

emergencyContacts.label: All emergencies, from a mobile phone
emergencyContacts.note: Works from any mobile, including one with no airtime.

emergencyContacts.label: On-site first aid and show duty contact
emergencyContacts.note: The committee will supply the on-site contact before the show.

showVisitorInfoDocument.expectIntro: What the show looks like from a visitor's side of the bench: when the doors open, what it costs to come in, and the practical details that decide whether you bring a camera, a coat or a cool box.

openingHours.label: Show days
openingHours.note: Dates and daily opening hours are still with the show committee.

openingHours.label: Final day
openingHours.note: The final day usually closes earlier to allow exhibitors to break down their displays.

showVisitorInfoDocument.admissionNote: Admission is charged per person per day, with concession rates for pensioners and children, and a reduced rate for members of affiliated SAOC societies. Whether tickets are sold at the door as well as in advance has not yet been confirmed. Current prices are shown on the ticket page.
showVisitorInfoDocument.food: Catering arrangements have not been confirmed. Details of what will be available on site, and whether visitors may bring their own refreshments, will be published once the committee confirms the venue.
showVisitorInfoDocument.photographyPolicy: The photography policy has not been confirmed. Personal photography is normally welcome at SAOC shows; tripods, flash near the benches, and any commercial or press photography usually need prior arrangement. Confirmed rules will be published here.
showVisitorInfoDocument.cloakroom: Cloakroom and plant-holding arrangements have not been confirmed. If you buy plants at the show, we expect a holding area will be available so you need not carry them for the rest of your visit — this will be confirmed.
showVisitorInfoDocument.accessibility: Accessibility details have not been confirmed. The working venue is a modern convention centre with step-free access and accessible facilities. Specifics — accessible parking, wheelchair availability, aisle widths between benches, and assistance on request — will be confirmed by the committee.
showVisitorInfoDocument.faqIntro: Answers to what visitors ask us most. Many of these depend on details the show committee has not yet confirmed; those answers are marked as such and will be updated as the arrangements firm up.
showVisitorInfoDocument.faqContactNote: Not answered here? We would rather hear the question than have you guess.

showFaqDocuments.question: How do I get to the show from Cape Town International Airport?
showFaqDocuments.answer: The venue is about 22 km from the airport, roughly 25 to 40 minutes by road. The MyCiTi A01 bus runs from the airport to Civic Centre station, about 600 m from the working venue. Full detail is on the Plan your visit page.

showFaqDocuments.question: Is there parking at the venue?
showFaqDocuments.answer: Parking arrangements have not been confirmed by the show committee. The working venue has several parking garages; we will publish rates and directions once the booking is confirmed.

showFaqDocuments.question: Where exactly is the show being held?
showFaqDocuments.answer: The venue has not been formally confirmed. We are planning around the Cape Town International Convention Centre and will update this page the moment the committee confirms.

showFaqDocuments.question: How much does it cost to get in?
showFaqDocuments.answer: Current prices are listed on the ticket page. They remain provisional until the council confirms them.

showFaqDocuments.question: Can I buy a ticket at the door?
showFaqDocuments.answer: Whether tickets will be sold at the door as well as in advance has not been confirmed.

showFaqDocuments.question: Are there concessions for pensioners, children or society members?
showFaqDocuments.answer: Yes — concession rates for pensioners and children, and a reduced rate for members of affiliated SAOC societies, are planned. The amounts are provisional until the council confirms them.

showFaqDocuments.question: Is the venue wheelchair accessible?
showFaqDocuments.answer: Accessibility specifics have not been confirmed. The working venue is a modern convention centre with step-free access and accessible facilities; we will publish the confirmed detail, including accessible parking and assistance on request, once the committee supplies it.

showFaqDocuments.question: Are assistance dogs welcome?
showFaqDocuments.answer: This has not been confirmed. Please contact us before the show so we can give you a definite answer.

showFaqDocuments.question: Can I buy plants at the show?
showFaqDocuments.answer: Plant sales are a normal part of a national show, but the sales arrangements for 2027 have not been confirmed.

showFaqDocuments.question: Can I leave plants I have bought somewhere while I carry on looking?
showFaqDocuments.answer: Cloakroom and plant-holding arrangements have not been confirmed. We expect a holding area will be available and will confirm here.

showFaqDocuments.question: Can I take plants I buy across a provincial or national border?
showFaqDocuments.answer: Moving plants across borders can require permits, and the requirements depend on where you are travelling to. Check with the relevant authority well before the show. We will add specific guidance once the committee confirms which sellers will be present.

showFaqDocuments.question: May I take photographs?
showFaqDocuments.answer: The photography policy has not been confirmed. Personal photography is normally welcome; tripods, flash near the benches and any commercial or press photography usually need prior arrangement.

showFaqDocuments.question: Will there be food and drink available?
showFaqDocuments.answer: Catering arrangements have not been confirmed.

showFaqDocuments.question: When is the show?
showFaqDocuments.answer: The dates have not been formally confirmed by the show committee. The countdown on the show page reflects our current working dates.

seedNotes: answer is a portableText field — the seed script must wrap each answer string in a proper block array: [{ _type: 'block', _key: <stable key>, style: 'normal', markDefs: [], children: [{ _type: 'span', _key: <stable key>, text: <answer>, marks: [] }] }]. Keys must be deterministic and derived from the document _id, not random — a random key changes the document on every run and defeats idempotence checking.

Every seeded answer above is deliberately either verified research or an honest 'not confirmed'. None of them invents a fact. This is the whole point of the mission's posture — read confirmation-status-model.golden.md before adding any FAQ.
The word 'confirm' appearing in placeholder copy is not itself the visible marker — the ConfirmationBadge is. Both are required.
